Telemetry and QR payment for vending and self-service car washes

Pay by Click or Payme QR at a vending machine, water station or self-service car wash, and see stock and takings remotely. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 96 mln; the full version in 12–20 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Controller board connected to the machine (MDB or pulse)
  • QR payment flow
  • Remote status
  • Sales dashboard
  • Alerts for errors and low stock
What the full version adds
  • A fleet of machines
  • Refill route planning
  • Prices by time of day
  • Loyalty
  • Fiscal receipts
  • Technician app

What we need from you

  • Site access and space for the devices
  • Internet or SIM cards
  • A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price
